description: Full-text search over the ~900 federal map layers on geo.admin.ch (noise, natural hazards, radon, zoning, protected areas, energy, transport, geology, …). Returns layer ids (e.g. 'ch.bafu.laerm-strassenlaerm_tag') with titles. Next: get_layer_info for fields/metadata, or query_layer_at_point to read values at a location. Examples: query='Strassenlärm', 'radon', 'Grundwasserschutz', 'solar', 'Bauzonen'.

lang.description: Language for labels/attributes: de, fr, it, rm or en (default en)

query.description: Keywords (any national language or English), e.g. 'noise', 'Hochwasser', 'antennas'

name: search_map_layers
title: Search the geo.admin.ch map layer catalogue
